verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kimi Code agents that read code, edit files, and run terminal commands inside a project folder. That is local coding automation, a related but different capability from seeing and operating desktop applications. Nothing documents screen perception or GUI control of other apps, and the browser-extension and agent-mode help entries are bare titles with no such capability described.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
